# How to build automated SEO workflows with SE Ranking MCP and GA4

 This guide shows you how to connect SE Ranking and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to Claude, then use a single prompt to build a live, interactive dashboard. You can refresh it any time, export it as a PDF, or reuse the same prompt for any domain.

 The full setup takes about **15 minutes**.

Getting started
Step 1: Connect SE Ranking MCP
Step 2: Connect SE Ranking SEO Skills
Step 3: Run the dashboard prompt
Step 4: Create a Live Artifact
Troubleshooting

---

## **Getting started**

Before you start, you'll need three things:

1. **A Claude account**.
2. **SE Ranking API access**. You’ll need API credits to pull data into Claude.
3. **A GA4 property** that you have viewer access to (or higher).

* **No SE Ranking account yet?** [Start a free 14-day trial](https://seranking.com/sign-up.html). It includes 100,000 API credits — enough for everything in this guide.

 If you need more credits to test our MCP, please contact us at [mcp@seranking.com](mailto:mcp@seranking.com).

*

---

## **Step 1: Connect SE Ranking to Claude**

In this step, you'll add SE Ranking as a custom connector in Claude. Once it's connected, Claude can pull live data directly from your account.

1. In Claude, open **Customize** >** Connectors**.
2. Click the **+** button and choose **Add custom connector**.
3. Fill in the details:
   - **Name:** SE Ranking
   - **Remote MCP server URL:** https://api.seranking.com/mcp
4. Click **Add**. SE Ranking will now show up under **Not connected**.
5. Click **SE Ranking** and then **Connect** to sign in and authorize.

That's it. Claude can now access your SE Ranking data.

**Prefer ChatGPT?** SE Ranking is also available as an official connector in ChatGPT. In ChatGPT, go to **Apps → Search apps → SE Ranking → Connect**, or open it directly at [the SE Ranking ChatGPT connector](https://chatgpt.com/apps/se-ranking/asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2).

---

## **Step 2: Connect SE Ranking SEO Skills to Claude**

A skill is a reusable recipe — built once, runs the same way every time.

1. Open **Customize** in the sidebar. (Plugins are available in Claude Cowork or Claude Code)
2. Click **Personal plugin** → **+ Create plugin**.
3. Click **Add marketplace** and enter: **seranking/seo-skills**

That's it — now you can access 24 SEO workflows in one install. Trigger a skill by typing its name, like `/seo-content-brief`, or just describe what you want and Claude will pick the right skill automatically.

Install once, then use the skills in every chat after that.

![GA4 MCP 2.png](https://help.seranking.com/hc/article_attachments/27397033316252)

---

## **Step 3: Run a dashboard prompt**

Use the **seo-google skill** in AI Chat to retrieve data from Google Analytics, then use the prompt below to build your dashboard.

**Step 1: Customize the prompt**
Before sending the prompt, replace all values in **[square brackets]** with your own details.

**Step 2: Send the prompt**
Paste your customized prompt into a new Claude chat and send it.

Claude will call **SE Ranking** and **GA4** one after another, then generate your dashboard.

#### Prompt — AI Search Visibility Dashboard

 Copy the prompt, then replace the highlighted items with your own details.

```
# AI Search Attribution Dashboard

For [domain] in the Google US database, audit our AI search visibility.

From SE Ranking:

1. First, identify our top 5 organic competitors for this domain in this market, and our top 50 highest-traffic keywords — these define the categories we should be visible in.

2. Pull [domain] overall AI search performance: which engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview) mention us, how often, and on which topics. Are we cited as a source or only mentioned in passing?

3. Run a head-to-head AI leaderboard against the 5 competitors you just identified, focused on the topic clusters tied to our top keywords. Who gets cited most? Which prompts surface a competitor but never us?

From GA4:

4. Pull the last 90 days of sessions from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, and Deepseek— by source and landing page. Compare to the prior 90 days.

Synthesize: Where are we cited, where are competitors winning, and which 3 pages should we update first to earn AI citations? For each, name the prompt we're losing, the competitor cited instead, and the specific gap to close.
```

*One live artifact creation with 2 data sources consumes about 15-20% of 5-hour limits in Claude Pro, or about 1-2% of weekly usage. Model — Sonnet 4.6*

---

## **Step 4: Live Artifact**

You can also create a **Live Artifact** — a live, interactive dashboard that you can refresh anytime to see the latest data.

You can build it using **SE Ranking data** right away.
If you’d like to include **GA4 data** as well, you’ll need to connect a separate **GA4 MCP** first.

Google’s official guide for setting up the GA4 MCP:
[developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/MCP](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/MCP)

After the setup is complete, simply use the same prompt as above to generate your Live Artifact.

![GA4 MCP.png](https://help.seranking.com/hc/article_attachments/27392486654748)

---

## **Troubleshooting: API key or connected-account issues**

If Claude returns an error saying your API key belongs to a different account, or the SE Ranking connector lists projects that aren't yours, the connection is authorized under the wrong account — your key itself is usually fine.

**Symptoms**

- An error that your API key "belongs to another account," even though you generated it in your own SE Ranking interface.
- The connector returns or lists projects that belong to someone else.

**How to fix it**

1. Confirm you are signed in to the correct SE Ranking account.
2. In Claude, open **Customize > Connectors**, disconnect SE Ranking, then connect and authorize it again while logged into that account.
3. If projects from another account still appear, regenerate (rotate) your Project Key and reconnect. This can happen when an account was set up with a shared Project Key that belongs to another user.

If the error persists after re-authorizing with the correct account, contact [**support@seranking.com**](mailto:support@seranking.com).

---

## **What's next**

A few ways to get more out of this setup:

- **Tweak the prompts.** Add new engines, change time ranges, or swap competitors to match how you report.
- **Combine with other connectors.** Pair SE Ranking with Slack, Notion, or Google Drive to push dashboards directly into your team's workflow.
- **Explore more SE Ranking tools.** Browse the full[ list of MCP tools](https://seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/) to see every data point you can pull into Claude.

---

Need more detail or help? See the full[ SE Ranking MCP setup guide](https://seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/) or email [**support@seranking.com**](mailto:support@seranking.com).
